base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: deep space with a vast star field, the planet curving below, the Tomkin-Mobile soaring with wings spread. Lighting: crisp starlight and sun flares.
In the shot: Ben Elf, a tiny elf about the height of a teacup, neat and bright-eyed, wearing a pointed green hat, a green jacket with eleven unnecessary pockets, and a belt hung with a small brass horn, a spare horn, a scroll, a magnifying glass, a bag of mixed nuts and a laminated official ID card; Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; the Tomkin-Mobile, a sleek, aggressive, low-slung racing car with the armoured bulk of a naval battleship, mirror-polished chrome and copper panels, retractable feathered metal wings that fold like a barn owl's, a tailpipe that puffs lavender-coloured bubbles, and a roof rack on top.
Camera: The car breaks into space; cut inside to Ben at the window.
Action: The Tomkin-Mobile bursts into silent space, the planet curving below. Inside, tiny Ben presses his face against the window, gazing at the stars.
Dialogue: Ben Elf (high-pitched, chipper, officious little male voice, delighted by everything, speaking in excited exclamations, overjoyed) says: "SPACE! I've counted the stars and there are at least TWELVE!"
Sound effects: engine hum muffling to quiet, nose squeak on glass, ambience of muffled rumble of the Meow-Drive.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
